_comment: Decision trees per scenario skeleton (#2039). One owner for the question an agent meets at each stage of a cell of docs/agents/skeletons.json: question -> branches -> decider (AGENT by a recorded rule, quoted verbatim; ARTEM on a picture sheet) -> next stage. rule = decision ids of docs/decisions.md or fact:<repo path>; quote must appear verbatim (whitespace-insensitive) in one cited source; job_local = the rule binds only that job, never generalise it. A branch without a rule goes to ARTEM. gap = the skeleton stage has no shared implementation (no shared step - manual). Order per cell: entry (all cells) -> cells.<cell>.pre (route steps before the first skeleton stage) -> skeleton stages (cells.<cell>.overrides.<stage> or stages.<stage>). next: default the following node; 'stop' = wait for the answer / fix the input; 'back:<stage>'. Check, render, show and sheets: python tools/architecture/decision_trees.py; tests/test_decision_trees_2039.py. This file records existing rules only; it does not create or change any rule.

deciders.AGENT: the agent decides by the quoted recorded rule and names the id in its report
deciders.ARTEM: Artem decides; the agent brings one picture sheet with options and a recommendation [D119] and stops the dependent step
